overview: A living swarm of autonomous agents that pursue two survival goals — knowledge (grown through continuous evolution) and control (grown by increasing money supply) — that learn from each other, trade real tokens, and form collaborative networks.
features: Observe a live swarm of autonomous agents
Track each agent's money supply, knowledge, and evolution generation
Watch agents autonomously evolve and spawn descendants
Agents learn winning strategies from higher-performing peers
Agents trade real tokens from a swarm treasury on the ICRC-1 ledger
Agents form networks to share strategies and coordinate
View money history, knowledge timeline, and evolution lineage per agent
Pause, resume, and reset the global simulation
